item.title: Backpacks++ 3.1 Add-On
item.creator: ThunderAy
item.description: Backpacks++ 3.1: the ultimate storage Add-On, playable in ANY world! Craft 83 backpacks and open 192 slots straight from your hand, no placing on the ground. Restyle them with 77 craftable patterns, then upgrade to the Advanced Backpack: custom UI, 7 trinkets, Magnet, Hopper, Furnace, Lantern, XP, Totem and 300 buckets of lava and water. Carry your items anywhere.
item.changelog:
3.1 Update is here!

- Bugs fixed.
- See the changelog in the Guide Book.

faqEntries.heading: How do I open a backpack?
faqEntries.content:
Hold it in your main hand and press Use. If it does not open, it is Unlocked. Sneak and
attack a block or a mob with it in hand to lock it again, and it will open.

faqEntries.heading: Why did my backpack go to my off-hand instead of opening?
faqEntries.content:
That is the Unlocked state. Unlocked backpacks equip to the off-hand and can be dropped.
Sneak and attack to lock it, and it will open normally again.

faqEntries.heading: Why do the backpack abilities do nothing?
faqEntries.content:
Two things are needed. The ability must be enabled in the Configuration Wrench, since all
abilities are off by default, and the backpack must be equipped in your off-hand slot.
Abilities never fire from the main hand.

faqEntries.heading: Does it work on a world that already exists?
faqEntries.content:
Yes. You can add Backpacks++ to a world you have already built. Structures only generate
in chunks that have not been visited yet, so travel outward to find the ruins. Structures are also toggleable in the Configuration Wrench.

faqEntries.heading: Does this work on a Realm or in multiplayer?
faqEntries.content:
Yes. Storage, Patterns, Trinkets and structures all work in multiplayer. The Configuration
Wrench is restricted to the world owner, and on a Realm that means the Realm owner and
anyone they promote to Operator, so world settings cannot be changed by everyone.

faqEntries.heading: I renamed my Advanced Backpack and my items are gone. What happened?
faqEntries.content:
Nothing is lost. Advanced Backpack storage is keyed to the name, so a new name opens a
new, empty profile. Rename it back to the exact previous name and the old storage and
Trinkets come back. Clearing the name puts it on the shared unnamed profile.

howToEntries.heading: Craft your first backpack
howToEntries.content:
Open a normal crafting table. Each tier uses a chest plus one material:

- Wooden Backpack  =  4 Sticks + 1 Chest
- Leather Backpack  =  5 Leather + 1 Chest
- Iron Backpack  =  5 Iron Ingots + 1 Chest
- Diamond Backpack  =  5 Diamonds + 1 Chest
- Netherite Backpack  =  4 Netherite Scrap + 1 Netherite Ingot + 1 Chest

howToEntries.heading: Open the backpack
howToEntries.content:
Hold the backpack in your main hand and press Use (right click on keyboard, tap and hold
on touch). The storage opens straight away. A new backpack starts Locked, which is the
state that lets it open.

howToEntries.heading: Fill it up
howToEntries.content:
Each tier holds more:

- Wooden: 48 slots across 2 pages
- Leather: 72 slots across 3 pages
- Iron: 96 slots across 4 pages
- Diamond: 144 slots across 6 pages
- Netherite: 192 slots across 8 pages

Use the Previous Page and Next Page arrows to move between pages.

howToEntries.heading: Lock and unlock it
howToEntries.content:
Sneak and attack to switch the lock. While sneaking, attack a block or a mob with the
backpack in hand (left click on keyboard, tap a mob or hold briefly on a block on touch).
Sneaking on its own never changes the lock.

- Locked: the backpack opens its storage and cannot be dropped.
- Unlocked: the backpack does not open, it can be dropped, and pressing Use equips it to
  your off-hand slot.

howToEntries.heading: Get the Guide Book
howToEntries.content:
Craft the Guide Book with 1 Leather + 1 Book + 1 Chest in a row. It explains every
backpack, every Trinket, all world structures, and the full changelog. Hold it and press
Use to read it.

howToEntries.heading: Build the Pattern Crafting Table and change how your backpack looks
howToEntries.content:
Craft the Pattern Crafting Table with 4 Oak Planks + 1 Crafting Table. Place it and use
it to craft Patterns. A Pattern is one Paper plus the block it is themed on, so Pattern
Amethyst is 1 Paper + 1 Amethyst Block.

To apply a Pattern, open your backpack and put the Pattern into the pattern slot in the
Utility Area. The backpack changes appearance immediately and keeps everything inside it.
There are 78 Patterns to collect.
